recent_commits.message: Tighten up terminology: workload, instance and service
Add message flow and PEP/PDP drill-down (arch-basic-ops)
Fix HTTP Sig replay text to reference nonce, not jti (#239) (#245)
Add trust anchors section; clarify WIT validation (#170) (#236)
add wit expiration security considerations and align across document (#242)
One workload identity per WIT and WIC (#203, #204) (#237)
Unify client authorization for WIT and WIC (#228) (#235)
use consistent wording on application & transport-level (#238)
Move wimse URI scheme to identifier draft; drop duplicate IANA (#207) (#225)
Add sentence about iss restrictions/allow list (#224)
Clarify iss RECOMMENDED for auditing and ops (#169) (#220)
Differentiate cloud provider credential from a workload identity (#78)
Reworked intro to remove normative language
Fix typos and enhance clarity in markdown document (#65)
Update organization for Joe Salowey to Palo Alto Networks
Trust domain is an opaque string
Sync up trust domain definition with architecture
Identifier on its own is not verifiable
Workload identifier is a full uri
Scheme may apply constraints to path
separate recordings box a bit more
tweak CSS for boxes on main screen
make single recordings button with list
Improved landing page for the WIMSE project
